opportunities.name: Account brief: company facts from SEC + Wikipedia emailed
opportunities.description: For a given ticker, look up the latest 10-K filing on SEC EDGAR, get HQ/employees/CEO from Wikipedia, and draft an 'Account brief' email to dana.
steps: Search ticker on SEC EDGAR company search and open the company
Filter filings by Form 10-K and open the latest Annual report; note filing date
Search company name on Wikipedia and open the article
Read HQ, employee count, CEO from infobox
Compose email to recipient with subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Body: '<Company>: HQ ..., employees, CEO ... Latest 10-K filed <date>.'
Discard/send the draft

opportunities.name: Supplier quote currency comparison emailed to procurement
opportunities.description: Convert two quoted amounts in two currencies to USD on Xe, get the supplier city's local time on timeanddate, and email procurement a 'Quotes' summary.
steps: On Xe currency converter set amount and source currency, target USD, Convert
Repeat for the second quote amount/currency
Determine cheaper quote
Search supplier city on timeanddate World Clock and read local time
Compose email to procurement with subject 'Quotes: <item>' and body with both conversions, cheaper currency, supplier local time
Discard/send

opportunities.name: Timezone and holiday sync email to ops
opportunities.description: For two cities and a month, find time difference on timeanddate Time Zone Converter, look up holidays for the country in that month, and email ops an avoidance note.
steps: Open Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Add city A and city B
Read time difference
Open Calendar > Holidays, choose country and month
Note holiday dates
Compose email to ops with subject 'Sync: A / B, <Month>' and body with offset and dates to avoid
Discard/send
